mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clazz ( name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: update clazz set name = #{name}, room = #{room}, begin_date = #{beginDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, master_id = #{masterId}, subject = #{subject}, update_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select c.*, e.name as masterName, case when curdate() < c.begin_date then '未开班' when curdate() between c.begin_date and c.end_date then '在读' else '已结课' end as status from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id
order by c.update_time desc
select c.*, e.name as masterName from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id where c.id = #{id}
